name: Kiro changelog
title: CLI: Hooks That Rewrite Tool Inputs and Answer Permission Prompts
headline: Kiro hooks rewrite calls and answer permissions
lede: Teams can use scripts to rewrite tool inputs before execution or answer permission prompts in V3 sessions.

effects.effect: Scripts can intervene before tool execution
Repeated tool approvals can be automated
Permission decisions become programmable team rules

possibilities.title: CI security fix gates can follow written team rules, not only model judgment

with.title: Cloudflare audit skill retains strong attention

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-11 Magpie suggested pairing Codex Security CLI with Kiro's Approve for Me so low-risk fixes land automatically; today's Kiro hooks let scripts answer permission prompts by explicit rule, and Cloudflare's audit skill supplies machine-readable findings those rules can read.

possibilities.title: Security teams can audit every automated agent permission answer as it happens

with.title: Kiro streams request and tool telemetry

possibilities.connection: Kiro hook scripts now answer permission prompts and rewrite tool inputs, and Kiro Enterprise now streams each completed tool call as an OpenTelemetry event, so each automated decision can be logged and checked live.
